propositions: The Cloud rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() rather than derived, allowing classified mutating methods to be renamed or moved into unswept modules without detection.

Currently exactly two definitions exist outside the swept four transport modules with names matching _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING: backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment, both pure self.transport delegations.
An anti-drift assertion must scan all unswept adapters/jira/ modules including acli_subprocess.py and jira_fields.py to detect classified mutating names appearing outside the swept transport surface.

The only allowed collision shape outside the sweep is a pure same-name self.transport delegation with arguments forwarded unchanged; any guard, retry, logging, transform, or non-transport target must fail the assertion.
The four swept transport paths must be an explicit named constant so the sweep's declared subject is reviewable and its scope remains bound to the transport layer, not widened to the entire package.
